title: Qualify a remote SRE role
task: Open a live job posting, extract the real must-haves, and check whether the role is actually remote — without applying.
summary: Browsy opened the Supabase posting in a real session, snapshotted the role, and extracted the requirements. Clinqy checked the native window. The run ended with a qualification note and no application action.

verdict.label: Qualified
verdict.detail: Remote-global, senior SRE scope. Compensation was not posted, so pay remains unknown.
